recommendation: Implement comprehensive medication management for hypertension patients
implementation_steps: Conduct medication reconciliation to identify discrepancies and interactions
Titrate antihypertensive therapy according to established protocols
Counsel patients on medication adherence and proper use
Identify and manage medication side effects
Optimize pharmacotherapy to improve blood pressure control
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led medication management interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in blood pressure control, medication adherence, and reduced cardiovascular events across multiple randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews.
citation: 2017 ACC/AHA/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/AGS/APhA/ASH/ASPC/NMA/PCNA Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults
